quiz.title: Test 5 – Family & School Vocabulary
quiz.description: 61 illustrated vocabulary questions about family and school.
quiz.subject: English

sections.title: Part 1 – Family
sections.instruction: Look at the cartoon picture. Read the question and choose the best answer.

questions.prompt: Who is the man that protects and takes care of your family?
Who is the woman that cooks delicious meals and gives you love?
Who is the boy that shares toys and plays football with you in your family?
Who is the girl that reads books and plays dolls with you in your family?
Who is the adult that raises and guides children in the home?
Who is the boy child of a mother and a father?
Who is the girl child of a mother and a father?
Who is the old lady that bakes sweet cakes and tells you bedtime stories?
Who is the old man that walks with you and teaches you good things?
Who is the brother of your mother or father?
Who is the sister of your mother or father?
Who is the child of your uncle or aunt?
Who is the tiny person that drinks milk and needs constant care?
options: That tiny person is a teenager.
That tiny person is a baby.
That tiny person is a parent.
That tiny person is an uncle.

questions.prompt: Who is the young person between thirteen and nineteen years old?
options: That young person is a baby.
That young person is a grandfather.
That young person is a teenager.
That young person is a parent.

questions.prompt: Who are the young boys and girls that go to school and love to play?
Who is the group of people including parents and children living together with love?
Who is a person connected to you by blood or marriage, like your uncle or aunt?
Who is the son of your brother or sister?
Who is the daughter of your brother or sister?
Who are your mother and father together?
Who is the child of your uncle or auntie?
What is a chart or drawing that shows all the members and relationships in a family?
options: That drawing is a family tree.
That drawing is a photo album.

questions.prompt: Who is the son of your stepfather or stepmother?
Who is the daughter of your stepfather or stepmother?
Who is the married man to a wife in a family?
Who is the married woman to a husband in a family?
Who is the warm and caring sister of your mother or father?
Who is the brother of your mother or father?
Who is the father of your mother or father?
Who is the mother of your mother or father?
Who is a brother or a sister that has the same parents as you?
Who is a young human being who is not yet an adult?
options: That young person is a child.

sections.title: Part 2 – School
sections.instruction: Look at the cartoon picture. Read the question and choose the best answer.

questions.prompt: What is the place where students go every day to learn and play?
Who is the person that teaches lessons and helps you learn at school?
Who is the young person that goes to school to study and listen to teachers?
What is the room in a school where students sit and study together?
What is the item with printed pages that you read to get information or stories?
What is the piece of furniture with a flat top that you write on at school?
What is the tool made of wood that you use for writing or drawing with graphite?
What is the small rubber item that removes pencil marks from paper?
What is the long straight tool that helps you measure lines and draw straight edges?
What is the book with empty pages that you write your daily lessons in?
What is the writing tool filled with ink that you use to write on paper?
What is the large white board on the classroom wall where the teacher writes with markers?
What is the small white or colored stick used for writing on a blackboard?
What is the piece of furniture that you sit on during lesson time?
What is the schedule chart that shows which subject you learn at what time?
What is the set of questions you answer to show how well you understand the lesson?
What is the bag you carry on your back to bring books and stationery to school?
What is the small pouch or box that holds your pens, pencils, and erasers?
What is the period of time when you learn a specific topic with your teacher?
What is the rest time between classes when you can relax, eat snacks, and play?
What is an area of study at school, such as Math, English, or Science?
What are the exercises or tasks that your teacher gives you to do at home?
What is the quiet room in a school filled with many books for reading and borrowing?
What is the electronic machine used for typing, searching information, and learning online?
What is the machine connected to a computer that prints words and images onto paper?
What is the special assignment or group work that students prepare and present together?
Who is the classmate that works together with you on a classroom activity?
What is the open outdoor area at school where children run and play games during break?
Who is a person you like, trust, and enjoy spending time with at school?
